title: The Product Line
subtitle: From ready-to-run agents to packaged industry products — four tiers, each usable on its own and stackable on the one below.

agents.name: General Agents
agents.summary: Ready to run, picked by scenario
agents.description: Agents for everyday work — Q&A, retrieval, documents, data analysis. Sign in and try one; no platform to stand up first, no data to wire first.

platform.name: Platform Products
platform.description: Data governance, knowledge engineering, model access, and agent orchestration. Everything above sits on this tier — and any single piece can be used alone.

industry.name: Industry Scenarios
industry.summary: Packaged around how an industry works
industry.description: Foundation capability assembled around the real working scenarios of low-altitude economy, emergency management, energy, and industrial operations — deployable as delivered.

workbench.name: Ruyin Workbench
workbench.description: A desktop workbench pulling agents, data, and everyday work into one place. This is where the three tiers below actually get used.
